_doc: Fixed lots in the compound: seven, five in the yard and two at the wall (round 11 cut the nine and three of the first rounds: the player chooses what to build first). kind: yard or wall. pos is the centre and size the width and height of the lot in tiles; work is where the builders stand (walkable, a step either side too, outside the footprint, reachable from the gate). Every lot is three tiles by three and centred on the middle of a tile, so that what a building shuts (assets/data/building_art.json, 'solid') is whole tiles: the back two rows of the lot, the front row (where the work spot is) is always open. The positions were checked against the map (tests/test_build_view.gd): on open ground inside the yard, clear of every prop, ladder, school door and the gate's lane, a person's width apart, and every work spot reachable. The seven that stay are spread round the edge of the yard and leave the middle free: none stands on the basketball court or in the garden, the school doors' ground stays open, and the two at the wall (the north wall's and the west wall's, for a watchtower or the floodlights) sit by the posts they would help.
